ShieldGen.name: Shield Generator
ShieldGen.desc: Barrier that absorbs ALL damage from 3 attacks (+2/lvl). Recharges if no hit is taken for 3s.

TargetingAI.name: Targeting Matrix
TargetingAI.desc: +15% Crit Chance, +35% Crit Damage & +15% Range per level.

Overclock.name: Reactor Overclock
Overclock.desc: +35% Attack Speed per level & +1 Extra Projectile Shot to all weapons.

VampiricCore.name: Vampiric Siphon
VampiricCore.desc: +22% Lifesteal Chance per level (heals ship for 35% of weapon & AoE damage).

ExplosivePayload.name: HE Blast Warheads
ExplosivePayload.desc: +1.6 AoE Blast Radius to all weapons & +20% Weapon Damage per level.

EmpDisruptor.name: EMP Stun Capacitor
EmpDisruptor.desc: +20% Stun Chance on hit per level, immobilizing enemies for 1.8s.

NanoRepair.name: Nano-Repair Bay
NanoRepair.desc: Repairs +6 Hull HP/sec during combat and +20 HP after each wave.

SalvageDrone.name: Chrono Accelerator
SalvageDrone.desc: +25% Attack Speed, +10% Crit Chance & +10% Stun Chance per level.
